name: RISEAssist – AI Chat Assistant for RISE AI
author: RISE AI

sections.description:
Give every visitor an instant answer, day or night. RISEAssist adds the RISE AI chat assistant to your site, so customers get replies in seconds while your team stays in control.

  • Answer customer messages around the clock. The assistant learns from your website and the knowledge you add, and replies in your brand’s tone.
  • Book appointments in the chat. Connect your booking calendar in RISE AI and the assistant offers times and books visitors in.
  • Recover abandoned carts. On WooCommerce stores, the assistant sees what is in the visitor’s cart and can send timely reminders and discount offers.
  • One inbox for your team. Website chats sit alongside your other channels in the RISE AI dashboard, where your team can watch any conversation and take over at any time.

RISEAssist connects your site to RISE AI, a customer communication service. It does not work on its own: you need a RISE AI account. New accounts start with a 5-day free trial; see riseai.ai for plans. Appointment booking and store automations are available on plans that include them.

Once connected, the plugin:

  • Adds the RISE AI chat widget to your site’s pages.
  • On WooCommerce stores, lets the assistant see the visitor’s current cart, so it can answer questions about the products in it.
  • On WooCommerce stores, saves the RISE AI visitor ID and the ordered items with each order, so RISE AI can follow up on the order (for example, by asking for a product review).
  • Works with the WP Consent API. When a compatible consent banner is installed, visitor tracking and store automations wait until the visitor allows statistics cookies. The chat itself always works.
  • Adds suggested text to your privacy policy guide, and supports the WordPress personal data export and erase tools.

All chat settings, the assistant’s knowledge and the conversations themselves are managed in the RISE AI dashboard, not in WordPress.

External services

This plugin connects your site to RISE AI, a third-party service run by RISE AI Technologies Pty Ltd. The service is required: without it the plugin has no function.

RISE AI service (riseai.ai)

  • When an administrator connects the site: the email and password (or pairing code) they enter, the site URL, the plugin version, and whether WooCommerce is active and its version. Sent from your server.
  • While connected: at most once every 15 minutes, when an administrator is in the WordPress admin, a status check with the same site details. Sent from your server.
  • When an administrator disconnects the site: the site’s connection ID. Sent from your server.

RISE AI chat widget (https://app.riseai.ai/boot.js and https://widget.riseai.ai)

  • Loaded on every front-end page while the site is connected. The visitor’s browser downloads the script and chat window from RISE AI, which receives the visitor’s IP address and browser details as with any web request.
  • Messages a visitor types in the chat, and any files they attach, are sent to RISE AI to generate replies and so your team can review the conversation.
  • On WooCommerce stores, after consent where a WP Consent API banner is used: the current page type, the visitor’s cart contents, and activity such as time on page, so RISE AI can send automated messages (for example, about an abandoned cart).
  • On WooCommerce stores: the visitor ID and ordered items are saved on the order, and reach RISE AI through the order data the store shares with it.

RISE AI Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.

Privacy

The plugin adds suggested text for your privacy policy under Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide. It registers with the WordPress personal data exporter and eraser, so RISE AI data saved on a customer’s orders is included in data exports and removed by erasure requests.

The widget stores a visitor identifier (the riseai_visitor_* cookie, plus browser storage) for 30 days after the last visit.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Open RISEAssist in the WordPress admin menu.
  3. Connect the site with a pairing code: in the RISE AI dashboard, open Integrations, choose WordPress or WooCommerce, copy the pairing code from the setup page, and enter it in the plugin.
    • If you prefer, choose Sign in with email instead, sign in with your RISE AI email and password, and choose a workspace.
  4. The chat widget appears on your site straight away. Manage it from the RISE AI dashboard.

To disconnect, open RISEAssist in the admin menu and choose Disconnect. Deleting the plugin removes its settings and the RISE AI data it saved on orders.
sections.faq:
Do I need a RISE AI account?

Yes. The plugin connects your site to the RISE AI service and does nothing without an account. New accounts start with a 5-day free trial.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes. On a plain WordPress site the plugin adds the chat widget. Cart and order features are only used when WooCommerce is active.

Does it support the WooCommerce block checkout and High-Performance Order Storage?

Yes. Order data is saved for both the classic and the block checkout, and the plugin is compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Does it work with consent banners?

Yes, with any banner that supports the WP Consent API (for example Complianz or CookieYes, together with the WP Consent API plugin). Until the visitor allows statistics cookies, the widget does not store a visitor ID or send store activity to RISE AI. Visitors can still use the chat.

Where do I change how the assistant replies?

In the RISE AI dashboard at app.riseai.ai. The plugin only connects the site.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Dashboard links and the chat loader now follow the RISE_AI_APP_URL setting, so test sites can point the plugin at a non-production RISE AI environment.

1.0.2

  • Plugin renamed to RISEAssist – AI Chat Assistant for RISE AI.
  • Updated the plugin description.
  • Version number now matches the release.

1.0.0

  • First release on WordPress.org.
  • Connect with a pairing code or a RISE AI sign-in.
  • Chat widget on all pages, loaded with the WordPress script API.
  • WooCommerce cart awareness and order linking, for the classic and block checkouts.
  • WooCommerce HPOS compatibility.
  • Detects when the site’s address no longer matches its connection (a moved site or a staging copy), and Disconnect on a copy leaves the original site connected.
  • WP Consent API support.
  • Privacy policy text and personal data export and erase.
